note: Per-frame pose scripts for Nezuko's v3 redraw (same conventions as tools/art_v3/poses/tanjiro.json and akaza.json). Frame counts, phase breaks and timing semantics match the shipped atlas; new clips (renzoku_2, renzoku_3, kakato, slide_kick, air_dive, air_land, air_spin) carry theirs in "new". She fights bare-handed with kicks and her fingernails as claws in the approved claw stance (input image 1: the feet a little wider than her shoulders, the knees bent, the lead hand an open claw at chest height, the rear hand a loose claw before her stomach, the bamboo muzzle on); the edit defaults change only her arms and hands (spec prompt.edit_keep / edit_change). Every clip uses wide 768x1024 columns: the haori, the long hair and her kicks do not fit a 512 column. The idle is warped from the approved key (spec/nezuko-idle-rig.json); round_intro is generated like any clip (redesigned 2026-10-18). guard_low is an edit of the crouch's last drawing (references/crouch-key.png, cut from the processed crouch), registered on crouch frame 5. The demon form is not redrawn (user decision 2026-10-18): awakened_combo (the MAX, always shown in the demon form) is marked keep_shipped and awakening_start stays in the kept awakened atlas. The last drawing of every move that returns to the stance is idle frame 0 (copy_frames "idle:0"; crouching moves end on crouch frame 5). "stance": clips that keep the stance's height (QA band vs the idle); "upright_frames" stand fully upright.

walk.intro: In-place forward walk cycle in her claw stance: knees slightly bent, the lead claw held in front at chest height and the rear claw before her stomach, a fierce glare above the muzzle. A light, stalking step; the top of her head stays within about 5 percent of input image 1. The arms and the head stay steady (at most 8 px of bob); the pelvis stays at the same X in every frame; the long hair and the haori sway with the step. A seamless loop, not a story of moving right.
frames: Contact: the near leg reaches forward RIGHT with the heel touching the ground, the far leg behind on the ball of its foot; claws held.
Weight: weight moves onto the near foot, both knees bend a little more, the far heel lifts; the haori swings back.
Passing: the far foot travels forward close to the ground under the pelvis, the near leg supports; body at its highest (still knees bent).
Opposite contact: the far leg now forward RIGHT with the heel down, the near leg behind on the ball of its foot (the legs swapped compared with frame 1); claws held.
Opposite weight: weight onto the far foot, knees bend a little more, the near heel lifts.
Opposite passing: the near foot travels forward under the pelvis, the far leg supports; flows directly into frame 1.

walk_back.intro: In-place BACKWARD walk cycle in her claw stance: she still faces RIGHT toward the opponent but steps back toward the LEFT, knees slightly bent, claws held before her, eyes on the opponent. Wary, light steps; the head stays within about 5 percent of input image 1; the pelvis stays at the same X in every frame. A seamless loop.
frames: The rear foot reaches back to the LEFT, its toes touching the ground first; the front foot stays planted; claws held.
Weight moves back onto the rear foot, both knees bend a little more.
The front foot slides back under the pelvis, close to the ground.
The front foot has become the rear foot, reaching back to the LEFT on its toes (the legs swapped compared with frame 1).
Weight moves back onto it, knees bend a little more.
The other foot slides back under the pelvis; flows directly into frame 1.

crouch.intro: Crouching from the claw stance: she squats low on bent knees, ready to pounce, both claws held before her chest.

Crouched and settled, the same low squat, a slight breath out.
Crouched hold: the same low squat as frame 4, claws up, eyes fierce (this drawing is held while she stays down).

jump.intro: Neutral jump pieces (each frame is a separate state used at a different moment of the jump): crouch to spring, rising, apex, falling, landing and recovered. Facing RIGHT.

Falling: legs starting to extend down toward the ground, claws ready, the hair streaming up.
Landing: touching down in a deep crouch, knees bent to absorb the fall, one hand low in front of her.
Return: back in the approved claw stance, almost identical to input image 1.

hit.intro: Taking a hit while standing: the impact snaps her head and torso back, then she recovers into her claw stance. Each frame is a separate pain drawing.

Recovering: straightening up, the claws rising.
Return: back in the approved claw stance, almost identical to input image 1.

hit_guard.intro: The last drawing of her hit reaction, held while she is stunned, an edit of the approved claw stance (input image 1): she is back in her stance but still hurting. The stance, legs, feet and body size never move, so the hit reaction ends exactly at the size and stance of the idle.

edit.keep: the size and the position of the figure, both legs, both feet, the stance, the kimono below the obi, the leg wraps and sandals, the costume design, the line weight and the colours
edit.change: her face expression, the tilt of her head, her shoulders, her arms and hands, and the haori and hair only where the shoulders move them
edit.rule: Never move, enlarge or shrink the body; the legs and feet stay exactly as in input image 1.

reviewed.0: hunched, head lowered: hair and shoulders merge into the head ruler; registered on idle frame 0
